_comment: Simulated AVR cycle costs for hot-path engine operations. Source of truth for the cost table mirrored in platform/sdl/perf.cpp. Calibrate via tools/perf_logger/calibrate.py against an Ardens Profiler capture, or hand-measure against avr-objdump + the datasheet.

SIM_FONT_DRAW_CHAR.note: glyph load + column blit for ~4-5 pixel chars

SIM_SPRITE_BLIT.note: progmem read + shift + OR into fb

budget._note: 16 MHz / 60 Hz = 266,667 cycles per frame. Anything beyond drops a frame on real hardware.
